name: simobe-lpm
title: SIMOBE — Glassmorphic Cyber-Tech Admin
description: Dashboard admin modern bergaya glassmorphism/cyber-tech: sidebar collapsible, header dengan theme switcher (light/dark/system), dan halaman login dengan animated mesh gradient. Cocok untuk aplikasi manajemen / SIM / panel admin.

style.vibe: glassmorphism, cyber-tech, gradient glow accents, subtle circuit grid

files.role: App shell: <html> dark-mode, sidebar + header + main @yield('content')
Sidebar glass collapsible (w-64/w-20), brand header, nav
Header fixed: toggle, gradient title, theme switcher 3-mode, profile dropdown
Halaman login: mesh gradient bg + glass card

adapt.blade: Pakai langsung. Sesuaikan brand, warna, dan item nav.
adapt.react: Ubah layout jadi <Layout> component. sidebarOpen & theme => useState + localStorage (atau zustand). Kelas Tailwind terbawa 1:1. Ikon: lucide-react. Animasi float/glow: framer-motion atau keep CSS keyframes. Sidebar collapsible => state boolean.
adapt.vue: Pakai <script setup>. sidebarOpen & theme => ref + VueUse useStorage. Kelas Tailwind sama. Ikon: lucide-vue-next.
adapt.next: Sama seperti React; taruh Layout di app/layout.tsx atau komponen shell. tokens.css => globals.css.

conventions.note: Stack Blade/jQuery server-rendered: inisialisasi select2 & DataTables via jQuery di @push('scripts'). Ikon pakai kelas <i class="fa-solid fa-...">.
